_meta.anthropic/searchHint: tab tabs window windows switch select close new open multi-tab chromium electron

description:
List and switch the tabs / windows of a Chromium (CDP) app (an Electron app's BrowserWindows or a Chromium browser's tabs), and open or close them.
The active tab is what describe / gesture-tap / screenshot / debugger-evaluate / open-url all operate on, so select a tab before driving it. tabIds (`t1`, `t2`, …) are stable for the session and never reused.
Use when an app exposes multiple windows or tabs and you need to inspect or drive one other than the current page, or to open/close a page during an e2e test.
Returns { tabs: [{ tabId, targetId, title, url, active, label? }] } after the action. Fails if the device is not a Chromium (CDP) device, or the requested tabId/label no longer matches a live tab.

action.description: list: enumerate tabs/windows. select: make a tab active. new: open a tab and activate it. close: close a tab; if it was active, another live tab becomes active.

label.description: `new` only: a memorable label usable interchangeably with the tabId.

tab.description: Target tab for `select` (required) / `close`: a tabId like `t2` or a label. `close` defaults to the active tab.

url.description: `new` only: URL to open (defaults to about:blank).

name: chromium-tabs
